name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when planning move-out repairs?

mainEntity.name: What are common pitfalls to avoid when planning move-out repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pitfalls include underestimating the time needed for repairs, failing to document the property's condition, not communicating clearly with your landlord, and neglecting to get multiple quotes. Another pitfall is attempting complex repairs beyond your skill level, which can lead to further damage and higher costs. Always refer to your lease agreement to understand your responsibilities and avoid unauthorized alterations. Proper planning and communication are key to a smooth move-out and full security deposit return.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid underestimating time, poor documentation, unclear landlord communication, not getting multiple quotes, and attempting complex repairs beyond your skill. Refer to your lease for responsibilities.
